review.feedback: English draft resting on a recount of the citation metric at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (16 of 16 recorded counts reproduced, 359 counts from 200 files), on synthetic what-if additions to those counts and on two assumed models (an effort split between real value and proxy inflation, and a forecast that moves its own target), computed by a deterministic analysis whose 25 self-checks pass. The draft concludes that the count records mentions and can be moved by adding files, that the project's own detection rule, which calls a high concentration of citations healthy, could be turned at the pin by 31 synthetic files of mentions, and that this sample cannot distinguish an honest count from an inflated one; nobody has been observed inflating it. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
